name: Groq
summary: Hosted GroqCloud inference API, mostly OpenAI-compatible, with official SDKs, service tiers, and remote MCP tool connectors.
description: Commercial fast-inference API (groq.com / GroqCloud). Established provider gap fill, not a claim of a brand-new launch. Official docs (console.groq.com/docs): “Fast LLM inference, OpenAI-compatible.” The OpenAI-compatible base URL is https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 with a Groq API key (GROQ_API_KEY; not created). Docs also publish official Groq Python (`pip install groq`) and TypeScript libraries and describe some unsupported OpenAI fields (including logprobs and N other than 1). Service tiers via the service_tier parameter: performance (enterprise), on_demand (default), flex (higher throughput, best effort, may return over-capacity errors), and auto. The Batch API has its own window and does not accept service_tier. Built-in tools include code execution and browser search on some models (code execution disclosed; not called). Remote tools and MCP connectors are documented at https://console.groq.com/docs/tool-use/remote-mcp. A dedicated public pricing URL was not available on 2026-11-15: https://groq.com/pricing and https://groq.com/pricing/ 308 to the site homepage, and https://console.groq.com/docs/pricing returned 404. Do not invent per-token rates. Usage is billed in the Groq console (Billing / Spend Limits docs exist; no numeric rate table was extracted). Legal index: https://groq.com/legal (200) including Privacy Policy at https://groq.com/privacy-policy and Groq Service Credit Terms. A public free-tier page was not found. https://docs.groq.com 301s toward the console docs; use https://console.groq.com/docs/overview. license proprietary; pricing paid. No signup or spend was used.

agent_access.notes: API key required (not created). OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.groq.com/openai/v1. Official groq Python/TS libraries. Service tiers: performance, on_demand, flex, auto.
